analysis.name: blade_multiplies_objects
analysis.summary: A spinning sword cuts bouncing tomatoes inside a circular boundary, doubling them on each cut until the container overflows.
analysis.physics: Emoji tomatoes bounce inside a 2D circular boundary. A rotating sword blade cuts tomatoes on contact, doubling them. Count grows exponentially until the container bursts open.
analysis.hook: Top text reads 'EVERY CUT DOUBLES A TOMATO' above a white circle containing 1 tomato and a spinning sword.
analysis.pacing: Starts slowly with single cuts, exponentially accelerates as object density increases, culminating in a chaotic explosion of tomatoes.
analysis.colours: Black background, white circular line, silver/gold sword, red and green tomato icons.
analysis.sound: Swoosh sound effects per slice, pitch-shifting repetition sound effect for each split, culminating in intense chaotic audio before resetting.
graphics: Bouncing tomato sprites with face graphics
analysis.spec: Canvas: 1080x1920. Top title: 'EVERY CUT DOUBLES A TOMATO' (white text, red tomato emojis). Counter below title: '[COUNT] TOMATOES'. Circle arena radius: 400px centered at (540, 1050). Rotating sword length: 450px pivoting near center. Physics: circular collision boundary, gravity=500px/s², elastic bouncing. Blade collision triggers split into two smaller objects with impulse away from blade line. When count > 800 or circle is full, circle line dissolves and objects explode outwards.

analysis.name: halal_rules_explainer
analysis.summary: Blocky 3D characters explain the four ethical rules behind Halal meat preparation.
analysis.physics: 3D blocky/toy character animations illustrating sequential instructional steps in a farm environment.
analysis.hook: Character shows a Halal logo: 'That halal sign on your chicken is a promise...'
analysis.pacing: Starts with hook, sequentially presents 4 rules with matching visuals, finishes with summary and CTA.
analysis.colours: Bright green grass, brown wood, yellow/red/blue blocky characters, white chickens, pastel blue sky.
analysis.sound: Clear narration voiceover, light background music, subtle farm sound effects (chicken clucks, knife sharpening).
analysis.spec: Format: 1080x1920 vertical 3D render. Topic: Explaining Halal slaughter rules visually using Roblox/Lego aesthetic. Scene 1 (0-3s): Character presents Halal icon. Scene 2 (4-11s): Rule 1 - Sharpen knife hidden from animals. Scene 3 (12-17s): Rule 2 - Keep animals out of sight during processing. Scene 4 (18-21s): Rule 3 - Provide water beforehand. Scene 5 (22-27s): Rule 4 - Recite blessing and make a swift, pain-free cut. Scene 6 (28-37s): Wrap up showing final package and 4 rule icons, closing with CTA.

items.explain: Ambient Escape toy-farm 3D explainer (bounce-engine ambient/blocky.py): blocky farmer + chickens, Kokoro voice, 2-3 word captions, 4 rule chips with sources, farm sounds, no music (channel rule). New topics = add a script to blocky.SCRIPTS.

analysis.name: ai_cave_flight
analysis.summary: 100 AI agents evolve to navigate a narrowing cave over 20 generations.
analysis.physics: 100 steering agents fly through neon cave walls. Wall collisions eliminate agents. Each generation mutates surviving flight paths until all 100 reach the end.
analysis.hook: Top text setting the challenge over Gen 1 agents crashing into glowing cave walls.
analysis.pacing: Fast cuts through generations 1, 2, 4, and 20. Crashes decrease until a perfect swarm run at generation 20.
analysis.colours: Dark violet background, neon purple walls, cyan agent dots, yellow impact rings.
analysis.sound: Upbeat synth melody with pop sounds on collisions and a completion chime at the end.
graphics: 100 glowing cyan particles with motion trails

analysis.spec: Canvas: 1080x1920 portrait. Cave: Two parallel sine-wave bezier curves (purple glow, width 300px narrowing to 120px). Agents: 100 cyan dots (r=8px) spawned at left edge with steering vectors. Engine simulates generations 1, 2, 4, 20. Crashes spawn yellow expanding rings (r=20px). Text at top: '100 AIs learning to fly through a cave' and 'Generation X / Still Flying Y/100'. Duration: 18s total, ending with success text card.
